message: No detected untrusted source handling: Remote data is fetched via requests.get and BeautifulSoup scraping (e.g., WCA website) with no checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned revisions.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is implemented; file uploads are only checked for allowed extensions and CSRF, not for data integrity.

No detected model integrity verification: Although sklearn linear_model is imported and used, no serialized model file is loaded, and there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision for any model weights or artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: No code in the pipeline validates label distribution, checks class balance, or detects anomalous training samples before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no training loop present in the code, and no backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are implemented.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: The code contains no adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any stress-testing of ML models; it is a Flask web application with cubing statistics utilities.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evaluation pipeline present; no held-out test sets, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics are implemented anywhere in the code.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs (probability bounds, NaN guards, or calibrated thresholds) visible in any of the provided code files.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline does not involve an LLM and there are no prompt-injection defenses, input filtering for prompt content, or output content moderation visible in the code.
